result.title: Toward Cross-Rubric Surgical Skill Assessment via Joint Embedding Prediction
result.summary: Expert review of surgical videos is essential for surgical training but labor-intensive, motivating AI-assisted skill assessment to provide feedback at scale. Although surgical assessment rubrics may use different language to describe similar skills, existing automated methods commonly predict predefined skill levels or numerical scores tied to fixed rubrics, limiting their ability to transfer across semantically equivalent assessment criteria. We propose Predictive Rubric Alignment (PRA), a joint embedding prediction approach that scores surgical videos using natural-language descriptions of skill levels. Rather than matching level probabilities, PRA predicts a rater-weighted combination of skill-level description embeddings. Adjacent description features define a score-parameterized path, and the predicted embedding is projected onto this path to read the score. We introduce two variants: \textit{PRA-item}, which uses learned queries for predefined assessment items, and \textit{PRA-cond}, which generates queries from textual item names to enable assessment of unseen items without retraining. On AIxSuture, a dataset of expert-rated suturing videos, PRA outperforms published baselines in skill classification. We further evaluate zero-shot transfer to the smaller surgical skill assessment benchmark JIGSAWS. Trained on only two AIxSuture rubric items, PRA-cond assesses unseen JIGSAWS items without further training, yielding positive score correlations and greater Grad-CAM overlap with instruments and suture than a description-matching baseline. These results support predictive rubric alignment as a promising direction for flexible and explainable automated surgical skill assessment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Predictive Rubric Alignment，用自然语言技能等级描述来给手术视频打分：不直接匹配等级概率，而是预测评分者加权的描述嵌入组合，再把该联合嵌入投影到相邻描述特征构成的路径上读出分数，并给出使用学习查询与由条目名称生成查询两种变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测连续嵌入并按描述特征路径投影解码标量」的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何从 latent 状态读出并核验连续量、以及用嵌入回归替代离散分类提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。
